client = LazopApiClient::Client.new(url, appkey, appSecret)
request = LazopApiClient::Request.new('/logistics/epis/xspace/rate')
request.add_api_parameter("platformName", "OneLink")
request.add_api_parameter("externalSellerId", "109001")
request.add_api_parameter("caseId", "2500000152175706")
request.add_api_parameter("ratingStar", "5")
request.add_api_parameter("ratingReasons", "[\"REASON_1\"]")

response = client.execute(request)
puts response.success?
puts response.body
